title: 第7章 兔妖求救猎人来袭第8章 贪婪猎人引入虎穴
content_zh:
大白兔在地上翻了几个滚，这才爬了起来，朝莫凡点了点头，然后兔子脑袋一阵摇动，顷刻间便化作了一个女子的面容。
果然是一个妖怪！
莫凡见状心中惊喜，同时他发现这兔妖长得也实在太好看了些。
撇开那兔子身躯不谈，仅仅是那张脸，已然称得上是大美女了。
肉乎乎的小脸蛋上有着一双水汪汪的大眼睛，猩红的眼珠子宛如两颗红宝石，皮肤白皙如玉，高挺的琼鼻下有着一张樱桃小口，头上那一头雪白长发却是肆意披散着，显得有几分凌乱，一对雪白的兔耳矗立在头顶，倒是并不显得突兀，反而平添了几分可爱。
“好一个女妖精！”
莫凡心中啧啧赞叹，旋即便听得那兔妖冲他说道：“蛤蟆老爷，求求你救救俺，有人类在追杀俺！”
人类？
莫凡闻言一惊，连忙问道：“什么样的人类，在哪里？”
他现在最怕的就是那些个道貌岸然的人类，一点都不带讲理的，尤其是那座山门中的女仙，更是恶毒如蛇蝎，见面就抓他去炼丹，简直不要太恐怖。
此刻听到有人类追来自是心惊不已。
“是个老猎人，追了俺好几个山头，应该要不了多久就会追来的，求求蛤蟆老爷你一定要救救俺！！”兔妖祈求道。
猎人？
莫凡眉头微蹙，再度开口问道：“你确定只是一个普通的猎人，而非那懂得法术神通的仙人？”
他的话却也令兔妖一怔，后者顿时苦笑道：“蛤蟆老爷你可真能开玩笑，俺们这地界儿哪儿有什么仙人啊？那就是一个普通的猎人，连守村人和捉妖人都不是。”
“只是一个普通人那你干嘛慌成这样？你可是妖怪，还会怕普通人？”莫凡一脸狐疑。
“蛤蟆老爷你是不知道我们这些小妖的苦，俺刚化妖不久，除了炼化了喉中横骨能够口吐人言，以及化出人头外，便再无半点神通，哪里是那老猎人的对手？”
“他手里有可以猎杀虎豹的精铁长矛，以及狩猎苍鹰的弓箭，很是可怕。”兔妖苦着一张脸说道。
听到这里，莫凡算是明白了一件事，那就是并非所有妖怪都能够在化妖时觉醒天赋神通！
这小兔妖就是个很好的例子。

只是让他郁闷的是这堂堂妖怪居然也能够被人类追杀，也算是妖族中的奇葩了吧？
“蛤蟆老爷，还求你能够看在同族的份上救俺一命，俺日后一定奉上真果灵草答谢老爷的救命大恩！”
兔妖见莫凡没有开口，当即学着人类作揖的模样朝他连连祈求。
莫凡没有急着应答，而是目光一转，再度冲小兔妖问道：“我见你这兔妖倒也机灵，似乎知道不少消息，你可知俺们这山脉中可还有其他妖怪同族？”
“俺当然……不好，那老猎人追来了！”
兔妖刚要开口作答，突然神情大变，抬起前爪指向远处惊呼起来。
莫凡见状顺势看去，果然见百余丈开外的林子里蹿出了一个身披兽皮，头发花白的老人。
那老人背上背着一杆长矛，肩头斜挎着一柄大弓，腰间更是系着装满箭矢的箭囊，一看就极其不好对付。
老人年纪虽大，但步履如风，行走速度极快，宛如一头山猿在腾挪，快速向这小山包靠近。
“这特么是普通猎人？”
莫凡见状双目一瞪，眼皮直跳，这老人的速度也太快了吧？
content_en:
The big white rabbit rolled a few times on the ground, then got up and nodded to Mo Fan. Then the rabbit's head shook, and in an instant it transformed into the face of a woman.
It is indeed a monster!
Mo Fan was pleasantly surprised when he saw this. At the same time, he found that the rabbit demon looked really good-looking.
Putting aside the rabbit body, her face alone made her a beautiful woman.
There is a pair of big watery eyes on the chubby little face, the scarlet eyeballs are like two rubies, the skin is as fair as jade, there is a small cherry mouth under the tall Qiong nose, the long snow-white hair on the head is spread wantonly, looking a bit messy, and a pair of snow-white rabbit ears stand on the top of the head, which does not seem obtrusive, but adds a bit of cuteness.
"What a succubus!"
Mo Fan sighed in admiration, and then he heard the rabbit demon say to him: "Master Toad, please save me, there are humans chasing me!"
Human?
Mo Fan was shocked when he heard this and asked quickly: "What kind of human being is where?"
What he is most afraid of now are those sanctimonious human beings who are not unreasonable at all, especially the female fairy in the mountain gate, who is as vicious as a snake and a scorpion. It is not too scary to catch him and make alchemy when he meets him.
At this moment, I was very frightened to hear that there were humans chasing me.
"He's an old hunter. He's been chasing me for several hills. He should be chasing me soon. Please, Master Toad, you must save me!!" the rabbit demon prayed.
hunter?
Mo Fan frowned slightly and asked again: "Are you sure you are just an ordinary hunter and not an immortal who knows magic powers?"
His words also made the rabbit demon startled. The latter suddenly smiled bitterly and said: "Master Toad, you can really joke. Where are there any immortals in our world? He is just an ordinary hunter, not even a village guard or a demon hunter."
"You're just an ordinary person, so why are you so panicked? You're a monster, why are you afraid of ordinary people?" Mo Fan looked suspicious.
"Master Toad, you don't know the suffering of us little demons. I have just transformed into a demon not long ago. Apart from refining the bones in my throat to speak human words and transforming into human heads, I don't have any magical powers. How can I be the opponent of that old hunter?"
"He has in his hands fine iron spears that can hunt tigers and leopards, and bows and arrows that can hunt goshawks. They are very scary." The rabbit demon said with a bitter look on his face.
After hearing this, Mo Fan finally understood one thing, that is, not all monsters can awaken their innate magical powers when transforming into monsters!
This little rabbit demon is a good example.
What just makes him depressed is that this majestic monster can actually be chased and killed by humans. Is it considered a weird thing among the monster clan?
"Master Toad, I beg you to save my life for the sake of your fellow tribesmen. I will definitely offer real fruit and spiritual herbs in the future to thank you for saving my life!"
Seeing that Mo Fan didn't speak, the rabbit demon immediately imitated the way humans bowed and prayed to him.
Mo Fan did not respond hastily, but turned his eyes and asked the little rabbit demon again: "I see that you, the rabbit demon, are quite clever and seem to know a lot of information. Do you know if there are other monsters of the same race in our mountain range?"
"Of course I... No, the old hunter is chasing me!"
Just as the rabbit demon was about to answer, his expression suddenly changed. He raised his front paws and pointed into the distance and exclaimed.
Mo Fan saw this and looked around, and sure enough he saw an old man with gray hair wearing animal skins jumping out of the woods more than a hundred feet away.
The old man carried a spear on his back, a large bow slung over his shoulder, and a quiver full of arrows tied around his waist. He looked extremely difficult to deal with.
Although the old man is old, he walks like wind and walks very fast, like a mountain ape moving quickly towards the hill.
"Is this an ordinary hunter?"
Mo Fan's eyes widened when he saw this, and his eyelids twitched. Isn't this old man's speed too fast?
